title: Check if All the Integers in a Range Are Covered
goal: Check that every integer in an inclusive target interval is covered by some input range.
strategy: Track the next uncovered integer while reading sorted ranges. Overlapping or adjacent ranges extend coverage; a range starting later exposes a permanent gap.
